external_references.description: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency. (2026, July 22). Iranian-Affiliated Cyber Actors Exploit Programmable Logic Controllers Across US Critical Infrastructure. Retrieved September 26, 2026.

objects.description: During the [2026 Iranian Water Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0065), [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) manipulated process logic, HMI, and SCADA displays. In addition to this, adversaries locked victims out by changing the PLCs management passwords.(Citation: CISA-AA26-097A)
